svg.title: iOS · Gallery · selection mode — Select Multiple, nothing selected yet · portrait
svg.desc: gallery.portrait.svg after the long-press menu's Select Multiple (App/GalleryView.swift selectionHeader + App/GalleryTile.swift selectionCircle, 2026-09-13): the compact header is replaced by the selection row — Done 15 pt semibold accent, "Select projects" 17 pt bold (the title until something is selected; then "N selected"), Select All 15 pt semibold accent, and the 32 pt Edit glyph, secondary and disabled until two or more are selected — 12 pt of vertical padding, so the divider sits at 117.5 and the grid starts 14 under it as before. Every tile wears the empty 22 pt circle top-leading, 6 pt in: black at 30 % with a 1.5 pt white ring. A tap on a tile — or on its circle — toggles it; the mode stays on until Done, or Done Selecting in the tile menu. A tap in a gutter or the margin selects none. Drawn from the iPhone 17 Pro simulator, 2026-09-13; LL_SELECT=multiple stages it.
svg.text: iOS · Gallery · selection mode · portrait · 393×852 pt
Select Multiple: the empty circle on every tile, Done · Select projects · Select All in the header
